name: bws-cockpit
description: Dashboard pane (Assumptions, Shelf, Board, Loop tabs) with a one-row action bar above the prompt, Editor & Device Guard for Unreal/Unity/Blender/adb, Finish-Line Guard, Project Locator, /handoff with a context nudge, and a worker model pin for subagents. Claude records assumptions and shelves tangents through its tools.

guard.title: Editor & Device Guard
guard.description: Block calls that cannot work (editor or device down) and add launch flags (Unity -automated, UE low-VRAM).

lowVramMode.title: UE low-VRAM flags
lowVramMode.description: auto: add them when another UE editor or Blender runs, or VRAM use is over the threshold. always / off.

vramThresholdMb.title: VRAM threshold (MB)
vramThresholdMb.description: In auto mode, VRAM in use at or above this counts as pressure.

lowVramCvars.title: Low-VRAM cvars
lowVramCvars.description: Comma-separated cvar=value pairs passed as -ini:Engine:[SystemSettings] overrides. Empty uses the built-in set.

refreshSeconds.title: Band refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the band re-probes editors and devices while a terminal or Desktop surface is attached.

backgroundProbe.title: Band background probe
backgroundProbe.description: Re-probe editors, VRAM and devices at session start, every refresh interval and after each turn. Each probe starts powershell, nvidia-smi and adb, which can flash a console window on Windows. Off: probes run only for /cockpit, the refresh button and the guard.

loopIdleMinutes.title: Loop: idle alert (minutes)
loopIdleMinutes.description: Alert when the running worker has made no tool call for this long.

loopSessionAlert.title: Loop: session alert
loopSessionAlert.description: Alert when the current unit reaches this many worker sessions.

loopDriverStaleMinutes.title: Loop: dead-driver alert (minutes)
loopDriverStaleMinutes.description: Alert when the driver says RUNNING but its 30-second heartbeat has not updated for this long.

finishLine.title: Finish-Line Guard
finishLine.description: Keep Claude going when this session's run folder still has open checklist items, and ask for evidence when it claims done without any.

finishLineMaxContinues.title: Finish line: continues per prompt
finishLineMaxContinues.description: How many times the guard may block a stop before your next prompt.

evidenceCheck.title: Finish line: evidence check
evidenceCheck.description: Block once when a reply claims the work is done but cites no evidence (test counts, receipt paths, commit hash).

finishLineHeadless.title: Finish line in headless sessions
finishLineHeadless.description: Also guard claude -p and SDK sessions (off by default so harness workers keep their own budgets).

ownerName.title: Finish line: your name
ownerName.description: What the Finish-Line Guard calls you when it asks Claude to mark an item that needs you, as in "(needs <name>: question)".

projectLocator.title: Project Locator
projectLocator.description: Index the projects under projectRoots: the find_project tool, /projects, Globs for .uproject/ProjectVersion.txt answered from the index, and a project list in home-folder sessions.

projectRoots.title: Project roots
projectRoots.description: Folders that hold your projects, separated by ;

workerModel.title: Worker model for subagents
workerModel.description: Run subagents of the types in workerAgentTypes on this model when the Agent call names none (e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5). Empty: off. An explicit model in the call still wins.

workerAgentTypes.title: Worker subagent types
workerAgentTypes.description: Subagent types the worker model applies to, comma-separated.

shelfPath.title: Shelf file
shelfPath.description: Path of the idea shelf JSON file. Empty: <CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude>/idea-shelf/shelf.json.

shelfNudge.title: Tell Claude to shelve tangents
shelfNudge.description: Add one line to the conversation's opening context with the open-idea count and the shelve_idea tool.

dashboardOnStart.title: Open the dashboard at session start
dashboardOnStart.description: Open the Dashboard pane (Assumptions, Shelf, Board, Loop tabs) when a session starts, on the first tab with something waiting. Needs a terminal 144 columns wide or Desktop.

handoffNudgePercent.title: Handoff nudge (context %)
handoffNudgePercent.description: Once per session, when the context passes this percentage, toast and highlight Handoff on the bar. 0 turns it off.
